verses.sanskrit: वैशम्पायन उवाच।क्रोशमात्रं ततो गत्वा ददृशुस्तान्महारथान्। शारद्वतं कृपं द्रौणिं कृतवर्माणमेव च॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said “Within two miles after his departure Dhritarashtra, met with those three great carwarriors, viz., Sharadvat's son Kripa, Drona's son (Ashvatthaman), and Kritavarman.

verses.sanskrit: ते तु दृष्ट्वैव राजानं प्रज्ञाचक्षुषमीश्वरम्। अश्रुकण्ठा विनिःश्वस्य रुदन्तमिदमब्रुवन्॥२॥
verses.english: As soon as the latter saw the blind king, possessed of great power, the three heroes sighed in grief and with voices choked in tears weepingly said,-'Your royal son, O king, having performed the most difficult feats, has, with all his followers, gone to the region of Indra.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रस्तव महाराज कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्। गतः सानुचरो राजञ्शक्रलोकं महीपते॥३॥
दुर्योधनबलान्मुक्ता वयमेव त्रयो रथाः। सर्वमन्यत्परिक्षीणं सैन्यं ते भरतर्षभ॥४॥
verses.english: We are the only three car-warriors of Duryodhana's army that are yet alive. All the others, O foremost of Bharata's race, have died.'

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्त्वा राजानं कृपः शारद्वतस्ततः। गान्धारीं पुत्रशोकार्तामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥५॥
अभीता युद्ध्यमानास्ते घ्नन्तः शत्रुगणान्बहून्। वीरकर्माणि कुर्वाणाः पुत्रास्ते निधनं गताः॥६॥
verses.english: Having said these words to the king, Sharadvat's son Kripa, addressing the griefstricken Gandhari, said to her,-'Your sons have fallen, performing heroic and wonderful deeds, in the battle-field.

verses.sanskrit: ध्रवं सम्प्राप्य लोकांस्ते निर्मलाञ्शस्त्रनिर्जितान्। भास्वरं देहमास्थाय विहरन्त्यमरा इव॥७॥
न हि कश्चिद्धि शूराणां युध्यमानः पराङ्मुखः। शस्त्रेण निधनं प्राप्तो न च कश्चित्कृताञ्जलिः॥८॥
एवं तां क्षत्रियस्याहुः पुराणाः परमां गतिम्। शस्त्रेण निधनं सङ्ख्ये तन्नः शोचितुमर्हसि॥९॥
verses.english: Death in battle by weapons has been described by the ancients as the best that a Kshatriya can obtain. You should not, therefore, grieve for any of them.

verses.sanskrit: न चापि शत्रवस्तेषामृद्ध्यन्ते राज्ञि पाण्डवाः। शृणु यत्कृतमस्माभिरश्वत्थामपुरोगमैः॥१०॥
verses.english: Their enemies, O queen viz., the Pandavas, too, have not been more fortunate. Hear, what we, headed by Ashvatthaman, have done to them.

verses.sanskrit: अधर्मेण हतं श्रुत्वा भीमसेनेन ते सुतम्। सुप्तं शिबिरमासाद्य पाण्डूनां कदनं कृतम्॥११॥
verses.english: Learning that your son had been killed unrighteously by Bhima, we massacred the Pandavas when asleep after entering these camp.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाला निहताः सर्वे धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमाः। द्रुपदस्यात्मजाश्चैव द्रौपदेयाश्च पातिताः॥१२॥
verses.english: All the Panchalas have been killed. Indeed, all the sons of Drupada, as also all the son of Draupadi, have been massacred.

verses.sanskrit: तथा विशसनं कृत्वा पुत्रशत्रुगणस्य ते। प्राद्रवाम रणे स्थातुं न हि शक्ष्यामहे त्रयः॥१३॥
ते हि शूरा महेष्वासाः क्षिप्रमेष्यन्ति पाण्डवाः। अमर्षवशमापन्ना वैरं प्रतिजिहीर्षवः॥१४॥
verses.english: Our enemies, the Pandavas, are all heroes and great bowmen. They will soon attack us, filled with rage, for taking vengeance on us.

verses.sanskrit: ते हतानात्मजाञ्श्रुत्वा प्रमत्ताः पुरुषर्षभाः। अन्विष्यन्तः पदं शूराः क्षिप्रमेव यशस्विनि॥१५॥
verses.english: Informed of the massacre of their sons, those foremost infuriate with rage, those heroes,-Oillustrious lady, will soon pursue us.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तु कदनं कृत्वा संस्थातुं नोत्सहामहे। अनुजानीहि नो राज्ञि मा च शोके मनः कृथाः॥१६॥
verses.english: Having caused this massacre we dare not stay. Grant us permission, O queen. You should not grievc.

verses.sanskrit: राजंस्त्वमनुजानीहि धैर्यमातिष्ठ चोत्तमम्। दिष्टान्तं पश्य चापि त्वं क्षात्रं धर्मं च केवलम्॥१७॥
verses.english: Grant us your permission also, O king! Summon fortitude, and observe the duties of a Kshatriya in their highest form.'

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्त्वा राजानं कृत्वा चाभिप्रदक्षिणम्। कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च द्रोणपुत्रश्च भारत॥१८॥
verses.english: Having said so to the king, and going round him, Kripa and Kritavarat man and Drona's son, O Bharata, without being able to take of men, son away their eyes from the wise king Dhritarashtra, urged their horses towards the banks of the Ganges.

verses.sanskrit: अवेक्षमाणा राजानं धृतराष्ट्रं मनीषिणम्। गङ्गामनु महाराज तूर्णमश्वानचोदयन्॥१९॥
अपक्रम्य तु ते राजन्सर्व एव महारथाः। आमन्त्र्यान्योन्यमुद्विग्नास्त्रिधा ते प्रययुस्तदा॥२०॥
verses.english: Leaving thàt place, O king those great carwarriors, with hearts stricken with anxiety, took one another's leave and separated from one another.

verses.sanskrit: जगाम हास्तिनपुरं कृपः शारद्वतस्तदा। स्वमेव राष्ट्रं हार्दिक्यो द्रौणिर्व्यासाश्रमं ययौ॥२१॥
verses.english: Sharadvat's Kripa went to Hastinapura; Hridika's son went to his own kingdom; while the son of Drona started for the hermitage of Vyasa.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ते प्रययुर्वीरा वीक्षमाणाः परस्परम्। भयार्ताः पाण्डुपुत्राणामागस्कृत्वा महात्मनाम्॥२२॥
verses.english: Thus those heroes, who had offended the great sons of Pandu, respectively proceeded to the places they selected, on one another.

verses.sanskrit: समेत्य वीरा राजानं तदा त्वनुदिते रवौ। विप्रजग्मुर्महात्मानो यथेच्छकमरिन्दमाः॥२३॥
verses.english: Having met the king thus, those heroes, went away before the sunrise, O king, to the places they selected.

verses.sanskrit: समासाद्याथ वै द्रौणिं पाण्डुपुत्रा महारथाः। व्यजयंस्ते रणे राजन्विक्रम्य तदनन्तरम्॥२४॥
verses.english: It was after this, O king, that the sons of Pandu, those great car-warriors, met the son of Drona, and displaying their prowess, defeated him, O king."
